title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #5

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In which city was Prophet Muhammad (S.A.W.) born? (1 mark)
   A. Makkah
   B. Nairobi
   C. Cairo
   D. Taif

2. In which sport is Kenya most famous for its athletes? (1 mark)
   A. Gymnastics
   B. Swimming
   C. Cycling
   D. Long-distance running

3. How did the leaders of Taif respond? (1 mark)
   A. They gave him gifts
   B. They joined him
   C. They accepted at once
   D. They rejected him rudely

4. The Qur'an mentions prophets in Surah 6 verses 84-86 and other places. Why should we learn their stories? (1 mark)
   A. To learn lessons and virtues
   B. To become kings
   C. To avoid work
   D. To boast

5. What is perseverance? (1 mark)
   A. Keeping on with determination
   B. Giving up
   C. Laziness
   D. Anger

6. Which of these is broadcast media? (1 mark)
   A. Radio
   B. Book
   C. Poster
   D. Magazine

7. Who is a shepherd responsible for his flock according to the hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Only teachers
   B. Every person responsible for those in his care
   C. Only traders
   D. Only kings

8. If you stretch your right arm toward the sunrise, you are facing roughly (1 mark)
   A. West
   B. East
   C. North
   D. South

9. Which surah is recited in every rak'ah of the prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Fatiha
   B. Al-Masad
   C. An-Nasr
   D. Al-Falaq

10. Which action shows cruelty? (1 mark)
   A. Watering a cow
   B. Throwing stones at a bird
   C. Giving shade
   D. Feeding a goat

11. Which of these should you never share with strangers? (1 mark)
   A. The weather
   B. Your favourite food
   C. Your favourite colour
   D. Your passwords

12. Kindness to animals is (1 mark)
   A. A waste
   B. Only for farmers
   C. An act of worship when done for Allah
   D. Forbidden

13. What is the Prophet's way of life called? (1 mark)
   A. The Hajj
   B. The Zakat
   C. The Sunnah
   D. The Qibla

14. How far are the arms washed? (1 mark)
   A. Only the wrist
   B. Up to the shoulder
   C. Only the palm
   D. Up to and including the elbows

15. Which is NOT a trait of the Prophet? (1 mark)
   A. Generosity
   B. Cheating in trade
   C. Truthfulness
   D. Patience

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Why is Abu Bakr called As-Siddiq? (3 marks)

17. Why are Al-Falaq and An-Naas called the two surahs of seeking refuge? (3 marks)

18. Explain why we should be kind to Allah's creatures. (4 marks)

19. Explain how belief in Raqib and Atid helps a child behave well. (3 marks)

20. Who were the three earliest converts studied in this lesson? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Makkah
   He was born in Makkah.

2. D — Long-distance running
   Kenya is known for its long-distance runners.

3. D — They rejected him rudely
   They refused.

4. A — To learn lessons and virtues
   The stories teach us how to behave.

5. A — Keeping on with determination
   The Prophet continued to invite.

6. A — Radio
   Radio and television broadcast.

7. B — Every person responsible for those in his care
   Recorded by Al-Bukhari and Muslim.

8. C — North
   Right arm east means facing north.

9. A — Al-Fatiha
   Al-Fatiha is a pillar of every rak'ah.

10. B — Throwing stones at a bird
   Harming animals for fun is wrong.

11. D — Your passwords
   Passwords keep you safe.

12. C — An act of worship when done for Allah
   Mercy pleases Allah.

13. C — The Sunnah
   Sunnah means the way of the Prophet.

14. D — Up to and including the elbows
   Qur'an 5:6 says to the elbows.

15. B — Cheating in trade
   He never cheated on weights or measures.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: He believed the Prophet at once and spoke the truth, so he is called the truthful.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for believing, 1 mark for truthfulness, 1 mark for title meaning.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: Both begin with "Qul a'udhu", meaning "Say: I seek refuge". In them we ask Allah to protect us from harm.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the opening words, 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for protection.

18. (4 marks)
   Answer: Allah made them and owns them; kindness earns mercy and reward; animals help us; kindness makes us kind to people.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: Words and actions are recorded, so the child speaks the truth, avoids wrong and does good, and repents when wrong.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for recorded deeds, 1 mark for good behaviour, 1 mark for repentance.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: Khadija, Ali and Abu Bakr.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for two names and 1 mark for the third.
